name: P0: the tab click takes the first .mb-release-art-sec in the page
why: org/image-handling.org P0. A foreign detail head's picture section shares the class without data-mb-art-ctx. A bare query finds it before the archive section, sees no loaded state and lets the tab navigate instead of opening the viewer.

name: P0: _artSectionFind() without a key ignores the tab flag
why: Without the adapter's `tab` test any marked section would do; with only archive sections on a MusicBrainz page that is the same section, so the spec cannot tell. Recorded as an overlap: it matters once a non-archive adapter (P1) builds a marked section on the same page.

name: P0: the load no longer goes through the adapter
why: The section must load through desc.load(); a section that never loads keeps its Loading note, and openRelease() waits for data-mb-art-state="ok" in vain.

name: P0: the sheet reads no records from the adapter
why: _releaseArtRenderSheet() reads desc.images(sec); an empty list renders the chips with All 0 and no tiles.

name: P1: an external tile's URLs are made protocol-relative like an archive's
why: Another site may not answer on https; its URLs must stay as the page gave them.

name: P1: an external tile gets the archive's hover card
why: The archive card speaks of edits and 1200 px; another site's picture keeps the fd-pic card.

name: P1: an external tile is loaded with a referrer
why: Another site's image is loaded without a referrer, as everywhere else the script shows one.

name: P1: an external front is labelled as the archive's main front
why: Discogs' primary image is not an archive's main front; its star says so.

name: P1: Discogs' images carry no type
why: Without types the chips read only "(no type) 5", and nothing is starred.

name: P1: the foreign sections share MusicBrainz's layout key
why: A foreign page's layout must not change the release page's Cover art layout, and the other way round.

name: P1: the viewer's bar shows the section's label instead of the page's title
why: The adapter's title() names the release; without it the bar says "Images".

name: P1: archive.org's pictures carry no type
why: The head's pictures get the type the Art column's card already guesses from the file name.

name: P1: Space on a head picture finds no section
why: Space opens the viewer through the art section's own click handler; without the section it does nothing.
